methodology: Every insight cites the specific ratio/period pair it is derived from in ratios_timeseries.json.

risk_signals.statement: ICB Islamic Bank has reported deeply negative Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) every single year from FY2012 (-73.33%, the earliest year in this dataset) through FY2025 (-291.87%, the worst year in the series), worsening in nearly every year, and negative shareholders' equity confirmed for FY2012-2013 and FY2016-2025 (from BDT -9,215mn in FY2012 to BDT -14,624mn in FY2025). This is not a data error: it is directly reported by the bank in its own audited financial statements every year, and represents sustained technical insolvency by conventional accounting and regulatory measures for at least 14 consecutive years — a severity and duration not observed at any other bank researched in this dataset (compare EXIM Bank's single-year FY2024 CAR breach, or GIB's one-year FY2021 deficit that was reversed within a year). The bank has operated under a Bangladesh Bank-appointed Administrator in place of a Board of Directors through FY2025 (Note 45 to the FY2025 audited financial statements).

Percentage of classified (non-performing) investments against total investments rose from 60.78% (FY2012, itself already extreme) to a peak of 90.68% (FY2024), then eased slightly to 84.29% in FY2025 — still meaning over four-fifths of the bank's entire investment book is classified as non-performing. The ratio has never been below 58% in the full 14-year series. The FY2025 easing is not evidence of a genuine turnaround: classified investments fell in absolute terms (BDT 6,724.54mn to 5,323.45mn) but so did the total investment book (BDT 7,415.88mn to 6,315.38mn, -14.84% YoY) — consistent with a shrinking, unrecoverable book rather than improving credit quality — and the bank posted its 14th consecutive net loss (BDT -808.91mn) in the same year.

The bank posted a net loss in every one of the 14 researched years. The loss deepened sharply in FY2024 (BDT -945.06mn, the largest annual loss since FY2012's BDT -1,061.04mn) after a partial improvement in FY2015 and FY2020-2022 (losses narrowing to as low as BDT -141.08mn in FY2015 and BDT -187.27mn in FY2020) that then reversed; FY2025's loss narrowed again to BDT -808.91mn. A 14th consecutive annual loss on an ever-more-negative equity base is not evidence of stabilization by itself — see capital_ratio_denominator_shrinkage below.

FY2022 was the only year in the series with a positive operating profit before provisions (BDT +129.75mn), though the bank still posted a net loss after tax and provisions that year (BDT -252.41mn) — a brief, partial operating improvement that did not reverse the underlying capital position.

Newly added Q1-Q3 interim data (2026-08-27) shows FY2022's net loss masked a brief window of genuine NET profitability (after tax and provisions, not just operating profit before provisions): H1-2022 alone posted a net profit after tax of BDT +12.36mn (EPS +0.02), the only positive after-tax half-year found anywhere in this bank's 2013-2026 interim series, driven by a one-off surge in cumulative 'Other operating income' to BDT 245.15mn for the half-year (vs a 2022_Q1.json Q1-2022-alone figure of BDT 24.12mn, implying most of the surge landed in Q2 alone). This reversed sharply and immediately: the 9-month cumulative net profit fell back to a loss of BDT -74.0mn (2022_Q3.json), implying a discrete Q3-2022 loss of approximately BDT -86.4mn, on the way to the full-year loss of BDT -252.41mn already in this dataset. The annual figure alone gives no indication that any part of the year was ever profitable after tax.

FY2025's CAR of -291.87% is dramatically worse than FY2024's -171.95%, but this is driven at least as much by the denominator collapsing as by the numerator worsening: Total Risk-Weighted Assets fell from BDT 835.58 crore (FY2024) to BDT 519.98 crore (FY2025), a 37.8% one-year drop, while Total Regulatory Capital (Tier-I & II) deepened by a comparatively modest 5.6% (BDT -14,368.00mn to -15,176.92mn). A shrinking RWA base makes an already-negative CAR mechanically worse even without a proportional deterioration in capital — the same 'ratio breaks when its base moves toward/through zero' distortion this dataset already flags for ROE under negative equity (see historical_context), here hitting CAR's denominator instead of ROE's. Analysts comparing this bank's CAR across years should read it alongside the absolute capital shortfall (capital_surplus_deficit: -19,368.00mn FY2024 to -20,176.92mn FY2025 — a much smaller relative move than the CAR% suggests) rather than the ratio alone.

historical_context: ICB Islamic Bank is, by a wide margin, the most financially distressed bank researched in this entire dataset. Its predecessor, The Oriental Bank Limited (originally Al-Baraka Bank Bangladesh Limited), was seized by Bangladesh Bank in 2006 following a major fraud scandal and later acquired by Switzerland-based ICB Financial Group Holdings AG in 2008. The bank has continued operating with deeply negative capital ever since, a pattern of sustained regulatory forbearance rather than resolution that is unique among the banks researched so far in this dataset. As of FY2025 (and per that report's own text, on an ongoing basis), Bangladesh Bank has dissolved the Board of Directors entirely and appointed Mr. Mamunur Rahman, an Executive Director of Bangladesh Bank, as Administrator exercising the powers of the Managing Director (Note 45 to the FY2025 audited financial statements) — this dataset has not independently confirmed the exact year this administration began. ROE figures in ratios_timeseries.json should be read with particular caution for this bank: dividing a net loss by negative equity can produce a misleadingly positive-looking number. FY2012-2024 handle this by computing ROE anyway and attaching a metric_note caveat; starting FY2025 this dataset instead leaves roe_pct null whenever equity is <=0 (the stricter, dataset-standard convention) — the historical entries have not been retroactively changed, so the convention differs by year within this same file.
data_gaps: UPDATE (2026-08-27): Q1-Q3 unaudited interim data has now been added for 2013-2014 and 2017-2026 (29 quarter-files; see quarterly/*.json and sources.json for full detail and methodology). Genuine remaining interim gaps, confirmed searched and not fabricated: 2011, 2012, 2015 and 2016 could mostly not be retrieved intact from Wayback Machine (repeated truncation/corruption of the only available captures); 2017 Q2, 2019 Q3 (a full statement was never found; only a thin, itself-unretrievable Price Sensitive Information announcement exists) and 2020 Q2 (no filing of any kind found) remain confirmed gaps with no primary source located. Interim filings for this bank never disclose CAR/CRAR or classified-investment/NPL percentages (confirmed across all 29 quarters extracted) -- only Q4/annual filings carry those two metrics, so ratios_timeseries.json's periods array remains Q4/annual-only by design; interim quarters are tracked in quarterly/*.json instead. Two items surfaced by the interim-data cross-checking are flagged for a future session's attention on the ANNUAL series (out of scope for the interim-only task that found them): (1) 2012_Q4.json and 2013_Q4.json's stored total_equity appears to use Tier-I regulatory capital rather than face-of-balance-sheet accounting equity, understating equity by almost exactly the BDT 552.885m 'Other reserve' -- corroborated via NAV-per-share cross-checks against both files' own stored nav_per_share fields (see sources.json for the full derivation); (2) starting with the Dec-2025 comparative column in the bank's 2026 interim filings, 'Other assets' and 'Other liabilities' both jumped by a matching ~BDT 3,218.24m versus 2025_Q4.json's audited figures (equity unaffected, confirmed consistent across two independent 2026 filings) -- likely a gross-up in how a suspended-profit or classified-investment-related asset-liability pair is now presented, cause not confirmed from the filings' own text. PREVIOUSLY NOTED: FY2011 could not be extracted (source PDF truncated, no replacement found) or sourced elsewhere. FY2014-2015 shareholders' equity was not independently located (only Tier-I+II regulatory capital, a related but distinct and not-directly-substitutable figure) and is left as a gap for those two years rather than approximated. Provisions kept against classified investments not located for FY2021-2022. IMPORTANT METHODOLOGICAL NOTE: the bank's own FY2024 annual report contains a one-year column-shift error in its 5-year summary table for the FY2020-2022 columns (confirmed by cross-checking against each of those years' own annual reports); this dataset uses each year's own first-column data instead of the FY2024 report's (mislabeled) comparative columns for those three years — see sources.json for full detail. FY2025 is sourced from the standalone Audited Financial Statements bundle only, OCR-extracted from a scanned filing because pdftotext returned 0 lines (see sources.json for the cross-validation used to establish confidence in the OCR); the fuller 'Annual Report 2025' with a multi-year comparative table had not been published as of retrieval (2026-08-26) and may supersede this once available. FY2025's Cost of Fund (8.60%, this report's own figure) is only cautiously comparable to FY2024's Cost of Fund: FY2024's own annual report says 6.49%, but this FY2025 report's comparative column for FY2024 says 7.65% — an unreconciled discrepancy recorded in sources.json, with the FY2024 record left unchanged. DATA-QUALITY FIX (2026-08-26): ratios_timeseries.json's roe_pct for every year with negative equity (2012-2013, 2016-2024 — 11 periods) was storing a mathematically-distorted positive value (loss / negative equity = positive) with only an explanatory metric_note attached, rather than being nulled per this dataset's own stated rule ('ROE must be null when equity <= 0', already applied to NBL). Corrected to null across all 11 affected years; FY2025 was already correctly null. No quarterly/<YEAR>_Q4.json file was affected since none of them store roe_pct as a line item for this bank — it is purely a ratios_timeseries.json-layer calculation.
